# Zephyr Lane Tool Library handbook (fictional)

Members may borrow up to three tools at a time. Power tools such as drills and sanders can be
borrowed for seven days.

Late returns cost nothing, but a member with a late tool cannot borrow another one until it is back.

The library is open on Saturdays from ten in the morning until two in the afternoon.

Damaged tools must be reported at the desk. Members are never charged for normal wear.
